note: 26 measured regions become 20 rows over 21 printed exhibits: 16 figures and 4 grids, with six second panels excluded as fragment-of-other. Table 5 'Ranking of actual investment model performance under different transaction costs' (p20) is printed with a caption, two columns and eight body rows but has NO measured region - the detector saw only the Table 4 grid on that page - so it is recorded here and in the notes file and not as a row: record.py only accepts boxes that exist in the measured set, and inventing one would pass the quote check while failing the region check. Section paths were re-read against the printed headings, because the detector assigns a region to the heading that follows it: Figure 4 belongs to 3.2, Figures 9 and 10 to 4.1.3, Figure 12 to 4.2.3, Figure 14 to 4.4.4, Figure 15 to 5.2.1, Table 3 to 5.2.2 and Tables 4-5 to 6.2.1. Caption side comes from PDF word coordinates, not from reading order: Figure 1's caption prints 13 points above its plate, Figure 12's caption is the first line of its page and above the artwork it names, and Figure 14's caption sits at the top of p17 under a plate that starts on the same page.
rules: Exhibits sit where a result is reported, not where the method is taught: Figures 1 and 16 are the only schematics and both restate the same pipeline, while every chart from 2 to 15 reports a number the prose then quotes [place.section_kind] [geometry.family].

The six two-panel plates are not composites of different chart types: each pair is the same construction printed twice, once per asset or per window, and the paper only merges them into one numbered exhibit when the caption names both halves [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.panel_layout] [geometry.shared_axes].
No panel shares an axis with its neighbour: every panel prints its own ticks and its own scale, and the two assets' y ranges differ by two orders of magnitude [geometry.shared_axes].
Nothing is three-dimensional and nothing encodes a value in colour: the only colour use is regime coding in Figures 11 and 12 and series identity elsewhere [geometry.three_d] [geometry.colorbar].
Keys are printed BELOW the axes when the plate compares series (Figures 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13) and omitted entirely when a single series is plotted (Figures 2, 3, 6, 8, 14, 15) [geometry.legend].

Extrema and point values are annotated on the artwork only in the statistical-description block: Figures 2 and 3 print max/min callouts and Figures 4 and 7 print a value label on every point, while no result chart prints a data label [geometry.data_labels] [geometry.printed_numbers].

Caption side is a property of exhibit type except once: all fifteen figure captions after Figure 1 print BELOW their artwork and all table captions print ABOVE their grid, while Figure 1's caption prints above its flowchart [caption.position].

Both numberings are the colon form - 'Figure N: <noun phrase>' and 'Table N: <noun phrase>' - running 5 to 19 words with no finite verb, no unit except Figure 13's parenthetical '(measured in U.S. dollars)' and Figure 14's 'return (%)', and no conclusion [caption.numbering] [caption.words] [caption.units] [caption.concludes].

The caption names the object, never the reading and never a variable symbol: no caption in the paper names gt or bt, and the one caption that states conditions states them as date windows, Figure 15's two market windows [caption.conditions] [caption.variables].

Pointers are split three ways and the number is not required: seven exhibits are introduced by a sentence that names the exhibit and no number ('the following statistical graphs', 'market are as follows:'), nine are cited by number, and three (Figures 15, 16 and Table 5) are never pointed at [mention.style] [mention.lead_pattern] [mention.count].

Two exhibits are pointed at BEFORE they print and one of those crosses a page boundary: Figure 4's lead sits at the foot of p6, Figure 14's pointer on p16 and its caption on p17, and Table 3 is read on p18 before the grid opens p19 [mention.first_page] [mention.lead_pages].

Reading sentences are formulaic and always a see-verb - 'It can be seen from Figure 2 and Figure 3 that ...', 'From the Figure 6 and Figure 7 below, we can observe that ...', 'Figure 11 and Figure 12 show that ...', 'From Table 3, the average annual rate ...' [mention.trail_sentence] [mention.read_sentences].

All four measured grids are horizontal-rules-only, with no zebra, no merged cell, no diagonal header, no continuation marker and no note row; the only unit carried by a grid is Table 1's dedicated Unit column [table.rule_style] [table.zebra] [table.merged_cells] [table.units_in_header] [table.note_sentence].

Grid width tracks column count, not importance: the two-column ranking grid is half measure, the three-column glossary is half, the six- and seven-column return grids run full width, and nothing is rotated [table.width] [table.orientation] [table.cols].
